info.text:
Wayfair sold over $12 billion of stuff it barely stocks.
FY2025: $12.5 billion in net revenue, but only $71 million of inventory on Dec. 31, 2025.
About 20,000 suppliers drop-ship over 40 million products, or park stock in Wayfair's CastleGate warehouses.
Q2 2026: $332 average order at a 30.0% gross margin, roughly $99.60 of gross profit on an average order (illustration), before ads, tech and staff. 2025 net loss: $313 million.
Sources: Wayfair FY2025 10-K and Q4 2025 results (Feb 2026), Q2 2026 results (Aug 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
